metadata.title: How to Find the Best Probate Leads First
metadata.author: probatedata
metadata.shortDescription:
𝗡𝗼𝘁 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗺𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲.

In this practical ProbateData walkthrough, Jonathan explains how to identify your strongest opportunities, narrow a large search without sacrificing lead quality, target specific ZIP codes, revisit historical cases, and find out-of-state petitioners.

𝗜𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗼, 𝘆𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻:

• What “Available,” “Unknown,” “Listed,” and incomplete market-status results mean
• How to rank probate opportunities as A, B, and C leads
• Which filters can reduce a large list while preserving contact quality
• How to use ZIP-code and historical searches
• Why out-of-state petitioners can be especially important prospects

ProbateData helps real estate professionals find, research, organize, and work probate opportunities more efficiently.

𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲: https://probatedata.com/

Platform screens and available features may change over time. Always verify property, court, title, contact, and market-status information before acting.

This video is for educational purposes and is not legal advice. Follow all applicable federal, state, and local calling, texting, email, direct-mail, privacy, and Do Not Call requirements.
